slides.label: WATCH EXPLAINED
slides.headline: What a tachymeter does
slides.credit: Photo: Daniel Zimmermann, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.label: A speed scale on the bezel
slides.headline: Times a stretch, not seconds
slides.body: Ref 310.30.42.50.01.001 Speedmaster Moonwatch Professional: USD 7,800, per The 1916 Company, 22 Nov 2026.

slides.label: How it works
slides.headline: Start, stop, read
slides.credit: Photo: Daniel Zimmermann, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
slides.body: Time one stretch with the chronograph, then read the scale at the stop.

slides.label: The catch
slides.headline: Needs a known distance
slides.body: The scale only works for a fixed distance, such as one kilometre.

slides.label: Also a tachymeter
slides.headline: The Rolex Daytona
slides.credit: Photo: Shuntfield / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
slides.body: Ref 126500LN steel: USD 15,900 retail, per The Watchology, July 2026.

slides.label: Reading on the scale
slides.headline: A 20-second km reads 180
slides.body: Start at one marker, stop at the next. Speed = 3,600 divided by seconds.
